name: East Lothian
title: East Lothian —
tagline: Golden beaches, links golf and Scotland's sunniest corner.
summary: East Lothian is a coastal county east of Edinburgh with long beaches, Bass Rock and some of the world's best links golf courses, including Muirfield.
Dunbar is the birthplace of John Muir, the Scot who helped found the US national parks movement.
